manifest.description: Cross-cutting corroborator: read operator-supplied runtime evidence (profile excerpts, query logs, benchmark output, metrics) and corroborate, refute, or quantify the static performance candidates the other detectors raised — promoting hypotheses to observed-cost diagnoses and capturing the measured baseline.
when_to_use: the operator supplied baseline_refs (profiles, query logs, benchmarks, metrics) and static candidates need runtime grounding
a static candidate must be promoted from possible-cost to observed-cost before it earns a remediation slice
the plan needs a Baseline section with concrete measurements and measurement method
static detectors disagree and runtime evidence can adjudicate which cost center dominates
anti_patterns: do not invent measurements — if baseline_refs are empty or unreadable, say the plan is advisory and recommend a baseline-capture slice
do not promote a candidate to observed-cost without a quoted measurement and its source
do not run benchmarks or ingest profiles automatically; only read operator-supplied evidence references
do not re-derive the static smell — corroborate the candidates handed to you
